ns2:course.label: Vikings to Volvos: Scandinavia
ns2:course.description: An introduction to the history, literature, and culture of Scandinavia and the Nordic region, from the Viking age until the modern era (700s-present). Includes discussion of Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Finland, Iceland, Faroe Islands, Svalbard, and Greenland. All readings in English. Same as HIST 254.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Humanities - Lit & Arts, and Cultural Studies - Western course.
